difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Chern classes of the tensor product of two finite locally free modules of ranks r and s, giving in particular the formulas for the first and second Chern classes as linear combinations of the Chern classes of the factors with binomial coefficients (statement lines 8566-8585, tag 0FA6). The proof reduces to the case where both modules are successive extensions of invertible modules by the same argument as in the dual case, constructs the lexicographic filtration of the tensor product whose successive quotients are the tensor products of the invertible pieces, and thereby writes all three total Chern classes as products of linear factors, from which the displayed formulas follow by expansion. The construction of the filtration is the substance, so the claim is H2.
